records.jp: 詩さん、読みたいものは見つかった？
records.en_original: Did you find something you want to read, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you find something you want to read, Uta?
records.en: Did you find something you want to read, Uta-san?

records.jp: 気になるものが多すぎて……。<CR>何を読もうか迷っています
records.en_original: There's so many I'm curious about... I just can't decide.
records.en_auxiliary: There's so many I'm curious about... I just can't decide.
records.en: There are so many that interest me...<CR>I cannot decide what to read.

records.jp: そっかあ。<CR>じゃ、そんな詩さんに私のお気に入りの本を！
records.en_original: I see. In that case, I'll give you one of my favorite books!
records.en_auxiliary: I see. In that case, I'll give you one of my favorite books!
records.en: I see.<CR>Then I'll give you one of my favorite books, Uta-san!

records.jp: 迷ったらコレ！<CR>カワイイ猫ちゃんの写真集～！
records.en_original: You can't go wrong with this one! It's a whole book of cute kitties!
records.en_auxiliary: You can't go wrong with this one! It's a whole book of cute kitties!
records.en: You can't go wrong with this one!<CR>It's a whole book of cute kitties!

records.jp: 猫の写真……<CR>見てみてもいいですか？
records.en_original: Picture of cats... May I take a look at it?
records.en_auxiliary: Picture of cats... May I take a look at it?
records.en: Picture of cats...<CR>May I take a look at it?

records.jp: あ……これ、いいですね。<CR>この猫、星崎さんに似ています
records.en_original: Ah...this is nice. This one looks like you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah...this is nice. This one looks like you, Ao.
records.en: Ah...this is nice.<CR>This one looks like you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: でっしょー？<CR>……って、そこ！？　っていうか似てる！？
records.en_original: I know, right? ...Wait, what?! You think it looks like me?
records.en_auxiliary: I know, right? ...Wait, what?! You think it looks like me?
records.en: I know, right?<CR>...Wait, what?! You think it looks like me?

records.jp: はい。今まで動物の写真に特に関心はなかったん<CR>ですが、初めて親しみを覚えました
records.en_original: Yes. I've never been interested in pictures of animals before, but for the first time, I feel an affection for these creatures.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I've never been interested in pictures of animals before, but for the first time, I feel an affection for these creatures.
records.en: Yes. I had never been particularly interested in photographs of animals,<CR>but for the first time, I felt a sense of familiarity.

records.jp: ……そっか。<CR>気に入ってくれたならよかった
records.en_original: I see... Well I'm glad you like it.
records.en_auxiliary: I see... Well I'm glad you like it.
records.en: I see...<CR>Well I'm glad you like it.

records.jp: じゃじゃんっ、参考書！
records.en_original: Ta-daaa! An encyclopedia!
records.en_auxiliary: Ta-daaa! An encyclopedia!
records.en: Ta-daaa! A reference book!

records.jp: なるほど。<CR>確かに何かの時に役に立つかもしれません
records.en_original: I see. It certainly looks like it could be useful at some point.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. It certainly looks like it could be useful at some point.
records.en: I see.<CR>It certainly looks like it could be useful at some point.

records.jp: 星崎さんは、努力を欠かさないんですね
records.en_original: You never let an opportunity to work hard go to waste, do you, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: You never let an opportunity to work hard go to waste, do you, Ao?
records.en: You never neglect your studies, do you, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: す、すみません。<CR>ちょっとだけ悪ふざけしました
records.en_original: ...S-sorry. It was a bad joke.
records.en_auxiliary: ...S-sorry. It was a bad joke.
records.en: S-sorry.<CR>I was only fooling around a little.

records.jp: 悪ふざけ……ですか？<CR>では、星崎さんのお気に入りではないんですね
records.en_original: A bad joke? You mean to say that this isn't one of your favorite books?
records.en_auxiliary: A bad joke? You mean to say that this isn't one of your favorite books?
records.en: A bad joke...?<CR>Then it isn't one of your favorites, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: はい。どっちかっていうと苦手です……
records.en_original: Yeah. To be honest, I'm really not a fan...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. To be honest, I'm really not a fan...
records.en: Yeah. To be honest, I'm really not a fan...

records.jp: 星崎さんは、時々不思議なことをしますね
records.en_original: You do strange things sometimes, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You do strange things sometimes, Ao.
records.en: You do strange things sometimes, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: そういう星崎さんは、<CR>さっきまで何を探していたんですか？
records.en_original: What is it you were looking for in the first place, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it you were looking for in the first place, Ao?
records.en: What is it you were looking for in the first place,<CR>Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: 私？　私は……
records.en_original: Me? I...
records.en_auxiliary: Me? I...
records.en: Me? I...

records.jp: 漫画を探してたんだ！<CR>目新しいものは、見つからなかったけどね
records.en_original: I was looking for manga! I couldn't find anything new, though.
records.en_auxiliary: I was looking for manga! I couldn't find anything new, though.
records.en: I was looking for manga!<CR>I couldn't find anything new, though.

records.jp: そうなんですね……<CR>星崎さんのお勧めがあれば、読んでみたいです
records.en_original: I see... If you have any recommendations, I would be interested in reading them.
records.en_auxiliary: I see... If you have any recommendations, I would be interested in reading them.
records.en: I see...<CR>If you have any recommendations, Hoshizaki-san, I'd like to read them.

records.jp: へえ！　詩さん漫画とか読むんだ
records.en_original: Oh! You read manga, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh! You read manga, Uta?
records.en: Oh! You read manga, Uta-san?

records.jp: いえ。多分ですけど……<CR>あまり読まなかった気がします
records.en_original: No. I'm not sure, but...I don't think I've read any.
records.en_auxiliary: No. I'm not sure, but...I don't think I've read any.
records.en: No. I am not certain, but...<CR>I do not think I read manga very often.

records.jp: でも、星崎さんが何を面白いと思うのか<CR>知りたいと思ったので
records.en_original: However, I am interested in what you find interesting, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: However, I am interested in what you find interesting, Ao.
records.en: However, I am interested in what you find interesting,<CR>Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: そう言われると、<CR>ちょっと照れくさいな
records.en_original: When you say it like that, I feel a little self-conscious.
records.en_auxiliary: When you say it like that, I feel a little self-conscious.
records.en: When you say it like that,<CR>I feel a little self-conscious.

records.jp: ここの図書館で傑作を発掘したら<CR>詩さんにも紹介するね！
records.en_original: But if I uncover a hidden gem in this library, I'll be sure to let you know, Uta!
records.en_auxiliary: But if I uncover a hidden gem in this library, I'll be sure to let you know, Uta!
records.en: But if I uncover a hidden gem in this library,<CR>I'll be sure to let you know, Uta-san!

records.jp: 小説を探してたんだ。<CR>ラノベとか置いてないかなーって
records.en_original: I was just looking to see if there were any YA novels.
records.en_auxiliary: I was just looking to see if there were any YA novels.
records.en: I was looking for novels.<CR>I wondered whether they had any light novels.

records.jp: ラノベ？
records.en_original: YA novels?
records.en_auxiliary: YA novels?
records.en: Light novels?

records.jp: そう、剣と魔法のファンタジーとか、<CR>可愛い女の子との学園生活とか……
records.en_original: Yeah, like fantasy stories about swords and magic, or stories about the school lives of cute girls...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, like fantasy stories about swords and magic, or stories about the school lives of cute girls...
records.en: Yeah, like fantasy stories about swords and magic,<CR>or stories about the school lives of cute girls...

records.jp: 星崎さんは、想像力が豊かなんですね
records.en_original: You have such a powerful imagination, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: You have such a powerful imagination, Ao.
records.en: You have such a powerful imagination, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: えっ！？　<CR>そ、そんなふうに褒められるの、初めてかも
records.en_original: What?! That might be the first time anyone's ever said that about me.
records.en_auxiliary: What?! That might be the first time anyone's ever said that about me.
records.en: What?!<CR>That might be the first time anyone's ever said that about me.

records.jp: 私は小説をうまく楽しめないことが多いので<CR>星崎さんが少し羨ましいです
records.en_original: I've never been able to properly enjoy novels, so I'm a little jealous.
records.en_auxiliary: I've never been able to properly enjoy novels, so I'm a little jealous.
records.en: I often have trouble properly enjoying novels,<CR>so I am a little jealous of you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: じゃあ詩さん、今度読書会する？<CR>ふたりで読めば、読み方も変わるかも
records.en_original: Then, let's start a book club! Reading something together might change the way you read.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, let's start a book club! Reading something together might change the way you read.
records.en: Then, Uta-san, shall we have a book club next time?<CR>Reading together might change the way you read.

records.jp: ……相手が私で、いいんですか？
records.en_original: You would read a book...with me?
records.en_auxiliary: You would read a book...with me?
records.en: Is it really all right for your reading partner to be me?

records.jp: もっちろん！
records.en_original: Of course!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course!
records.en: Of course!

records.jp: ありがとうございます。<CR>楽しみにしてますね
records.en_original: Thank you very much. I'm looking forward to it.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you very much. I'm looking forward to it.
records.en: Thank you very much.<CR>I'm looking forward to it.

records.jp: うん！<CR>よーし、そうと決まれば……
records.en_original: Sure! Okay, now that that's decided...
records.en_auxiliary: Sure! Okay, now that that's decided...
records.en: Sure!<CR>Okay, now that that's decided...

records.jp: 今日はたっくさん読むぞー！
records.en_original: I'm gonna read a mountain of books today!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm gonna read a mountain of books today!
records.en: I'm gonna read a mountain of books today!

records.jp: 私も一緒にいいですか？
records.en_original: Would you mind if I joined you?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you mind if I joined you?
records.en: Would you mind if I joined you?

records.jp: うん、あっちの窓際の机で読もっか
records.en_original: Of course not! Let's read at that desk over by the window.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course not! Let's read at that desk over by the window.
records.en: Of course not! Let's read at that desk over by the window.

records.jp: ……うーん、面白かったあ！
records.en_original: Ahh, that was a good one!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, that was a good one!
records.en: Ahh, that was a good one!

records.jp: …………あれ？　詩さん？
records.en_original: ...Huh? Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Huh? Uta?
records.en: ...Huh? Uta-san?

records.jp: ね、寝てる……<CR>ここ、静かだもんねえ
records.en_original: Sh-she's sleeping... I suppose it is nice and quiet here.
records.en_auxiliary: Sh-she's sleeping... I suppose it is nice and quiet here.
records.en: Sh-she's sleeping...<CR>I suppose it is nice and quiet here.

records.jp: ……ふふ、可愛い寝顔
records.en_original: Hehe. She looks cute when she's asleep.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. She looks cute when she's asleep.
records.en: Hehe. She looks cute when she's asleep.

records.jp: （起こすのも悪いし、<CR>　もう少し詩さんを眺めてようっと）
records.en_original: (I don't want to wake her. Maybe I'll just stare at her a little longer.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't want to wake her. Maybe I'll just stare at her a little longer.)
records.en: (I'd feel bad waking her,<CR>so I'll keep watching Uta-san a little longer.)

records.jp: そういえば、どんな本が気になってたの？
records.en_original: Well, show me a couple you're interested in.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, show me a couple you're interested in.
records.en: By the way, what kind of books caught your interest?

records.jp: そうですね……
records.en_original: Let's see...
records.en_auxiliary: Let's see...
records.en: Let's see...

records.jp: このあたりの本ですと、<CR>次に読もうと思っていたのは、これです
records.en_original: Out of these, I was thinking of reading this one.
records.en_auxiliary: Out of these, I was thinking of reading this one.
records.en: Out of these,<CR>I was thinking of reading this one.

records.jp: えーっと……『宇宙と脳とゼロの関係』？<CR>美弦さんが読みそうな本だなあ
records.en_original: Let's see... The Correlation Between the Brain, the Universe, and Zero. Sounds like something Mio would read.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's see... The Correlation Between the Brain, the Universe, and Zero. Sounds like something Mio would read.
records.en: Let's see... The Correlation Between the Brain, the Universe, and Zero.<CR>Sounds like something Mio-san would read.

records.jp: 物語は、私には少し難しくて
records.en_original: Fiction is a little difficult for me.
records.en_auxiliary: Fiction is a little difficult for me.
records.en: Stories are a little difficult for me.

records.jp: 私としては、こっちのほうが難しいような……
records.en_original: Something like this would be difficult for me...
records.en_auxiliary: Something like this would be difficult for me...
records.en: Something like this would be difficult for me...

records.jp: でも、詩さんが気になってるなら<CR>私も頑張って読んでみるよ！
records.en_original: But if that's what you want to read, I'll do my best to follow along!
records.en_auxiliary: But if that's what you want to read, I'll do my best to follow along!
records.en: But if you're interested, Uta-san,<CR>I'll do my best to read it too!

records.jp: 分かりました。<CR>……私も物語に挑戦してみます
records.en_original: All right. I'll give it a shot.
records.en_auxiliary: All right. I'll give it a shot.
records.en: Understood.<CR>I will try reading a story too.

records.jp: 私もいつか、星崎さんの好きな本を<CR>一緒に楽しめるようになれたらな……
records.en_original: I hope I'll be able to enjoy a book that Ao likes together with her someday...
records.en_auxiliary: I hope I'll be able to enjoy a book that Ao likes together with her someday...
records.en: I hope that someday I will be able to enjoy a<CR>book you like together with you, Hoshizaki-san...

records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
